quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: for embodied-AI robots it mainly supplies thermal materials, fans, liquid-cooling systems, lightweight structural parts, joint modules, dexterous hands and embodied robots. Its controlled subsidiary Shenzhen Guoli Intelligent Technology focuses on biomimetic dexterous hands and dexterous manipulation; the hands' force-control and motion-control solutions are all self-developed and use tactile, proprioceptive and soft intelligent sensing units, position sensing units and temperature sensors for multimodal perception, led by its R&D department. The related products are at sample, test or small-batch supply stages with several customers, and the business is still a small share of company revenue.
